'''Heln''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|lieutenant]] who served the [[Imperial Military (Sith Empire)|Imperial Military]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on [[Balmorra/Legends|Balmorra]]. While tracking some [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Imperial]] [[Pilot/Legends|pilots]] who were captured by [[Balmorran resistance|resistance]] [[Sniper/Legends|snipers]], he tasked an Imperial [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] to rescue the [[Prisoner/Legends|captive]] pilots.
